title: Subject Pronouns
formula: I/you/he/she/it/we/they đứng trước động từ làm chủ ngữ
example: She studies English.

title: To be – Affirmative
formula: I am; he/she/it is; you/we/they are
example: He is a teacher.

title: To be – Negative & Questions
formula: S + am/is/are + not; Am/Is/Are + S...?
example: They aren't tired.

title: Object Pronouns
formula: me/you/him/her/it/us/them sau động từ hoặc giới từ
example: Please call her.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Singular & Regular Plural Nouns
formula: Thông thường thêm -s; sau s/sh/ch/x thêm -es
example: I have two boxes.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Irregular Plural Nouns
formula: child→children; man→men; woman→women; foot→feet
example: Two children are here.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Countable & Uncountable Nouns
formula: countable: a/an, numbers, many; uncountable: some, much
example: I need some advice.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Indefinite Articles
formula: a + âm phụ âm; an + âm nguyên âm; xét âm, không chỉ chữ viết
example: She is an engineer.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Definite Article & Zero Article
formula: the cho đối tượng xác định; không mạo từ với ý nghĩa chung trong nhiều trường hợp
example: The sun is bright.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Demonstratives
formula: this/that + singular; these/those + plural
example: These books are new.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Possessive Adjectives
formula: my/your/his/her/its/our/their + noun
example: Her bag is blue.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Possessive Pronouns & 's
formula: mine/yours/his/hers/ours/theirs; noun + 's
example: This book is mine.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Have / Has (got)
formula: I/you/we/they have; he/she/it has
example: She has a bicycle.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: There is / There are
formula: There is + singular/uncountable; there are + plural
example: There are three chairs.

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Some & Any
formula: some thường câu khẳng định; any thường phủ định/câu hỏi
example: Do you have any milk?

group: Danh từ, mạo từ & sở hữu
title: Basic Quantifiers
formula: many + countable plural; much + uncountable; a lot of + cả hai
example: How much time do we have?

title: Adjectives & Word Order
formula: adjective + noun; to be + adjective
example: She has a red dress.

title: Prepositions of Place
formula: in/on/under/behind/between/next to chỉ vị trí
example: The keys are on the table.

title: Prepositions of Time
formula: at + giờ; on + ngày; in + tháng/năm/buổi
example: My class starts at 8 a.m.

title: Present Simple – Affirmative
formula: S + V(s/es) cho thói quen và sự thật
example: I work every day.

title: Third-person Singular
formula: he/she/it + V-s/es; consonant+y→-ies
example: He watches TV.

title: Present Simple – Negatives
formula: I/you/we/they don't + V; he/she/it doesn't + V
example: She doesn't like coffee.

title: Present Simple – Questions
formula: Do/Does + subject + base verb...?
example: Does he play football?

title: Adverbs of Frequency
formula: before main verb; after be: always/usually/often/sometimes/never
example: She often reads at night.

title: Present Continuous – Affirmative
formula: S + am/is/are + V-ing
example: They are studying now.

title: Present Continuous – Questions & Negatives
formula: Am/Is/Are + S + V-ing?; S + be + not + V-ing
example: Are you listening?

title: Present Simple vs Continuous
formula: routine: present simple; happening now: continuous
example: I am cooking right now.

title: Can / Can't
formula: can/can't + base verb; Can + S + V?
example: She can swim.

title: Imperatives & Let's
formula: base verb; Don't + V; Let's + V
example: Please sit down.

title: Basic Conjunctions & Sentence Building
formula: and (thêm), but (đối lập), or (lựa chọn), because (lý do)
example: I stayed home because I was tired.

title: Past Simple – To be
formula: I/he/she/it was; you/we/they were
example: I was tired yesterday.

title: Past Simple – Regular Verbs
formula: S + V-ed; visited, stopped, studied
example: She visited Hue last year.

title: Past Simple – Irregular Verbs
formula: go→went; buy→bought; see→saw
example: We went to the beach.

title: Past Simple – Questions & Negatives
formula: Did + S + V?; S + didn't + V
example: Did you call her?

title: Past Time Expressions
formula: yesterday, last..., ... ago; in + year
example: They left two hours ago.

title: Past Continuous
formula: S + was/were + V-ing
example: I was reading at 9 p.m.

title: Past Simple vs Past Continuous
formula: past continuous (nền) + when + past simple (xen vào)
example: I was sleeping when he called.

title: Used to – Introduction
formula: used to + V: thói quen/trạng thái trước đây nay thay đổi
example: I used to live in Hanoi.

title: Comparative – Short Adjectives
formula: short adjective + -er + than
example: My bag is heavier than yours.

title: Comparative – Long & Irregular Adjectives
formula: more + long adjective + than; good→better
example: This book is more interesting than that one.

title: Superlatives
formula: the + -est hoặc the most + adjective
example: She is the tallest in her class.

title: Equality Comparisons
formula: as + adjective/adverb + as
example: She is as tall as her sister.

title: Adverbs of Manner
formula: adjective + -ly; irregular: good→well
example: He speaks clearly.

title: Future Simple – Will
formula: will + V, dự đoán/đề nghị/quyết định tức thời
example: I will help you.

title: Be Going To
formula: am/is/are going to + V
example: She is going to study abroad.

title: Present Continuous for Future
formula: am/is/are + V-ing + lịch hẹn tương lai
example: We are meeting tomorrow.

title: Will vs Going To
formula: will: quyết định tức thời; going to: dự định/ dấu hiệu
example: Look at the clouds! It's going to rain.

title: Present Perfect – Experiences
formula: have/has + V3; ever/never
example: I have never visited Japan.

title: Present Perfect – Recent Events
formula: have/has + just/already/yet + V3
example: She has already finished.

title: Present Perfect – Duration
formula: have/has + V3; for + duration; since + starting point
example: We have lived here for five years.

title: Past Simple vs Present Perfect – Introduction
formula: past simple = thời gian đã hết; present perfect = liên hệ hiện tại
example: I saw her yesterday.

title: Should / Shouldn't
formula: should/shouldn't + V nguyên mẫu
example: You should get more sleep.

title: Must / Mustn't / Have to
formula: must: bắt buộc; mustn't: cấm; don't have to: không cần
example: You mustn't smoke here.

title: May / Might / Could
formula: may/might/could + V cho khả năng
example: It might rain tonight.

title: Gerunds – Basic
formula: enjoy/avoid/finish + V-ing
example: I enjoy reading.

title: Infinitives – Basic
formula: want/decide/hope + to V
example: She wants to leave.

title: Zero Conditional
formula: If + present simple, present simple
example: If you heat ice, it melts.

title: First Conditional
formula: If + present simple, will + V
example: If it rains, we will stay home.

title: Time Clauses
formula: when/after/before/until + present khi nói tương lai
example: I'll call you when I arrive.

title: Basic Relative Clauses
formula: who = người; which = vật; that = cả hai trong defining clauses
example: The woman who called is my aunt.

title: Present Perfect vs Past Simple
formula: have/has + V3 vs past V2; finished time → past
example: I have seen that film before.

title: Present Perfect – Duration
formula: How long...? for + duration; since + point
example: She has known him since 2020.

title: Present Perfect Continuous
formula: have/has been + V-ing
example: I have been studying for two hours.

title: Perfect Simple vs Continuous
formula: have done = kết quả; have been doing = quá trình
example: She has written three emails.

title: Past Perfect
formula: had + V3 trước một mốc quá khứ khác
example: They had left before I arrived.

title: Narrative Tenses
formula: past simple = sự kiện; continuous = bối cảnh; perfect = trước đó
example: I was walking when I remembered I had lost my keys.

title: Past Habits & Familiarity
formula: used to + V; be/get used to + noun/V-ing
example: I'm used to waking up early.

title: Future Continuous
formula: will be + V-ing
example: This time tomorrow, I'll be flying.

title: Future Perfect
formula: will have + V3 + by time
example: By Friday, I'll have finished.

title: Future Time Clauses
formula: as soon as/until/by the time + present for future
example: I'll wait until you arrive.

title: First Conditional – Extended
formula: unless = if not; provided that = với điều kiện là
example: Unless it rains, we'll go out.

title: Second Conditional
formula: If + past simple, would + V
example: If I had more time, I would travel.

title: Preferences
formula: would rather + V; would prefer + to V
example: I'd rather stay home.

title: Wish & If Only – Present
formula: wish + past simple for unreal present
example: I wish I knew the answer.

title: Passive Voice – Present & Past
formula: be + V3; object → new subject
example: The letter was sent yesterday.

title: Passive Voice – Other Tenses
formula: has been/will be/is being + V3
example: The bridge has been repaired.

title: Passive Agents & Instruments
formula: by + người/tác nhân; with + dụng cụ
example: The window was broken with a stone.

title: Defining Relative Clauses
formula: who/which/that/whose + clause xác định
example: The man who lives next door is kind.

title: Non-defining Relative Clauses
formula: , who/which/whose ..., bổ sung thông tin
example: My brother, who lives in Hue, is a doctor.

title: Relative Pronouns & Omission
formula: Có thể lược who/which/that khi đóng vai trò tân ngữ trong defining clause
example: The book I bought is useful.

title: Reported Statements
formula: said (that); told + object (that); backshift thường gặp
example: She said she was tired.

title: Reported Questions
formula: asked if/whether + S + V; asked Wh + S + V
example: He asked where I lived.

title: Reported Commands & Requests
formula: asked/told + object + to V; not to V
example: She told me to wait.

title: Indirect Questions
formula: Could you tell me + wh/if + S + V?
example: Could you tell me where he lives?

title: Question Tags
formula: positive + negative tag; negative + positive tag
example: You are ready, aren't you?

title: Modals of Deduction – Present
formula: must = rất chắc; might = có thể; can't = khó có thể
example: She must be at home.

title: Modals – Obligation & Permission
formula: have to/be allowed to/be supposed to + V
example: We're allowed to park here.

title: Gerunds & Infinitives
formula: enjoy + V-ing, decide + to V, avoid + V-ing
example: They decided to leave early.

title: Verb Patterns – Meaning Changes
formula: stop doing = ngừng hoạt động; stop to do = dừng để làm
example: He stopped smoking.

title: Phrasal Verb Grammar
formula: separable: turn it off; inseparable: look after her
example: Please turn it off.

title: Concession
formula: although + clause; despite/in spite of + noun/V-ing
example: Although it rained, we went out.

title: Purpose, Reason & Result
formula: to/in order to + V; so that + clause; because of + noun
example: She left early to catch the bus.

title: Correlative Structures
formula: both...and; either...or; neither...nor
example: Neither Tom nor Ben is here.

title: Determiners
formula: each/every + singular; all/most + plural or uncountable
example: Each student has a book.

title: Noun Clauses – Introduction
formula: that/what/whether/if + clause làm danh ngữ
example: I know that she is right.

title: Third Conditional
formula: If + had + V3, would have + V3
example: If I had studied, I would have passed.

title: Mixed Conditionals
formula: If + past perfect, would + V (kết quả hiện tại)
example: If I had slept earlier, I wouldn't be tired now.

title: Wish & If Only – Past Regrets
formula: wish + past perfect; if only + had + V3
example: I wish I had listened.

title: Modal Perfects – Regret
formula: should/ought to/needn't have + V3
example: You should have called me.

title: Modal Perfects – Deduction
formula: must/might/can't have + V3
example: He must have forgotten.

title: Modal Perfects – Possibility
formula: may/might/could have + V3
example: She may have missed the train.

title: Future Perfect Continuous
formula: will have been + V-ing
example: By June, I'll have been working here for five years.

title: Advanced Perfect Aspect
formula: perfect simple nhấn kết quả; perfect continuous nhấn quá trình
example: I've written five reports today.

title: Perfect Infinitives
formula: to have + V3 cho hành động xảy ra trước
example: She seems to have left early.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Impersonal Passive Reporting
formula: It is said/believed/reported that + clause
example: It is believed that the plan will work.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Personal Passive Reporting
formula: S + is said/believed + to V/to have V3
example: He is said to live abroad.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Causative Structures
formula: have/get + object + V3
example: I had my phone repaired.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Get Passive vs Be Passive
formula: get + V3 thường mang tính sự kiện/thay đổi trạng thái
example: He got injured during the match.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Passive with Modals & Perfect Forms
formula: modal + be + V3; modal + have been + V3
example: The work should have been finished.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Present Participle Clauses
formula: V-ing clause, main clause (cùng chủ ngữ)
example: Walking home, I saw an accident.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Past & Perfect Participle Clauses
formula: V3 clause; Having + V3; Having been + V3
example: Having finished, she left.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Reduced Relative Clauses
formula: who is V-ing → V-ing; which was V3 → V3
example: The man standing there is my uncle.

group: Bị động & mệnh đề rút gọn
title: Non-finite Clauses of Purpose & Result
formula: to V cho mục đích; only to V cho kết quả không ngờ
example: She arrived only to find the office closed.

title: Advanced Reporting Verbs
formula: admit/deny + V-ing; urge + O + to V
example: He admitted making a mistake.

title: Reported Speech – Advanced
formula: backshift & deictic shift phụ thuộc ngữ cảnh
example: She said she would arrive the next day.

title: Future in the Past
formula: would + V; was/were going to + V
example: I knew she would win.

title: Complex Noun Clauses
formula: what/whatever/whoever/whether + subject + verb
example: I don't know whether he agrees.

title: Advanced Relative Clauses
formula: preposition + whom/which; whereby
example: The company for which she works is growing.

title: Advanced Quantifiers
formula: few/a few; little/a little; either/neither
example: We have a little time left.

title: Determiner Contrasts
formula: each/every/any/whole + đúng dạng danh từ
example: Every student is welcome.

title: Advanced Gerund & Infinitive Patterns
formula: verb + O + to V; preposition + V-ing
example: She persuaded him to join.

title: Verb Patterns – Meaning Contrasts
formula: try + V-ing (thử cách); try + to V (cố gắng)
example: Try drinking more water.

title: Advanced Concession
formula: much as + clause; in spite of + noun/V-ing
example: In spite of the rain, we continued.

title: Contrast Clauses
formula: whereas/while + clause thể hiện đối chiếu
example: He likes tea, whereas I prefer coffee.

title: Result & Degree Clauses
formula: so + adjective + that; such + (a/an) + noun + that
example: It was so cold that we stayed inside.

title: As If / As Though
formula: as if + clause; unreal past nhấn mạnh giả định
example: He acts as if he knew everything.

title: Preferences & Unreal Time
formula: would rather + V; would rather S + past; It's time S + past
example: I'd rather you stayed here.

title: Introduction to Inversion
formula: negative adverbial + auxiliary + S + V
example: Never have I seen this before.

title: Ellipsis & Substitution
formula: so + auxiliary + subject; neither + auxiliary + subject
example: I love music, and so does she.

title: Emphasis & Cleft Sentences
formula: It was X that/who...; do/does/did + base verb
example: It was Anna who solved the problem.

title: Negative Adverbial Inversion
formula: Rarely/Never + auxiliary + S + verb
example: Rarely have I seen such courage.

title: Sequencing Inversion
formula: No sooner had S + V3 than...; Hardly had S + V3 when...
example: No sooner had I arrived than it rained.

title: Conditional Inversion
formula: Had + S + V3; Were + S + to V; Should + S + V
example: Had I known, I would have helped.

title: So / Such Inversion
formula: So + adjective + be/aux + S + that...
example: So difficult was the exam that many failed.

title: It-cleft Sentences
formula: It is/was + focus + who/that + remainder
example: It was John who called me.

title: Wh-cleft Sentences
formula: What + clause + be + focus
example: What I need is a break.

title: Fronting & Topicalisation
formula: Đưa thành phần lên đầu để nhấn mạnh và tạo mạch thông tin
example: That decision, I regret.

title: Advanced Ellipsis
formula: Bỏ phần có thể phục hồi từ ngữ cảnh
example: She can swim, and I can too.

title: Advanced Substitution
formula: do so / one(s) / such để tránh lặp
example: He promised to call and did so.

title: Nominalisation
formula: Đổi động từ/tính từ thành danh từ để tạo văn phong học thuật
example: The decision surprised everyone.

title: Complex Noun Phrases
formula: determiner + premodifier + noun + postmodifier
example: The rapid growth of cities is worrying.

title: Apposition
formula: noun phrase, explanatory noun phrase, + clause
example: Marie Curie, a pioneering scientist, won two Nobel Prizes.

title: Mandative Subjunctive
formula: recommend/insist/essential that S + base verb
example: They insisted that he be present.

title: Counterfactual Subjunctive
formula: If I were... dùng cho giả định trái thực tế
example: If I were you, I'd apologise.

title: Advanced Modality
formula: may well + V; might conceivably + V
example: She may well be right.

title: Counterfactual Modals
formula: could/might/would have + V3
example: The outcome might have been different.

title: Advanced Non-finite Clauses
formula: having + V3; having been + V3 cho bị động hoàn thành
example: Having been warned, he left.

title: Absolute Constructions
formula: noun + V-ing/V3/adjective, main clause
example: Weather permitting, we'll leave early.

title: Proportional Comparisons
formula: The + comparative..., the + comparative...
example: The more you practise, the better you get.

title: Advanced Correlative Comparisons
formula: not so much A as B; no more...than
example: It's not so much a rule as a guideline.

title: Advanced Articles & Determiners
formula: article choices with abstract, generic and institutional nouns
example: Education plays a vital role.

title: Advanced Tense & Aspect
formula: was to have + V3; had been meaning to + V
example: I had been meaning to call you.

title: Hedging
formula: appear/seem/tend to; likely to; apparently
example: The results appear to support the theory.

title: Distancing & Evidentiality
formula: reportedly/allegedly/is understood to + V
example: The company is reported to be expanding.

title: Advanced Concession & Qualification
formula: notwithstanding + noun; much as + clause
example: Much as I respect her, I disagree.

title: Alternative Conditional Structures
formula: provided that/assuming/supposing/lest + clause
example: We can proceed provided that everyone agrees.

title: Academic Cohesion
formula: nevertheless/insofar as/in light of + appropriate form
example: In light of the evidence, we revised the plan.

title: Parallelism
formula: giữ cùng cấu trúc ngữ pháp trong liệt kê/so sánh
example: She likes reading, writing and travelling.

title: Extraposition & Anticipatory Subjects
formula: It is + adj + that-clause/to-infinitive
example: It is clear that the policy failed.

title: Punctuation, Scope & Formal Register
formula: semicolon nối hai independent clauses liên quan; dấu phẩy dùng đúng chức năng
example: The plan was risky; nevertheless, it succeeded.

title: Subtle Tense Nuances
formula: past progressive/intended future/remote past tùy sắc thái
example: I was going to call you, but I forgot.

title: Complex Aspect & Time Reference
formula: past perfect continuous cho quá trình trước mốc quá khứ
example: She had been waiting for hours when he arrived.

title: Fine-grained Modality
formula: may well/might just/could conceivably cho mức độ chắc chắn
example: That may well be the case.

title: Layered Counterfactuals
formula: giả định khác thời điểm; phối hợp would be/would have V3
example: Had she accepted, she might be leading the team now.

title: Rhetorical Inversion
formula: Gone are the days when...; never before has...
example: Gone are the days when paper records dominated.

title: Advanced Fronting
formula: fronted object/adverbial shifts information focus
example: That argument, I simply cannot accept.

title: Complex Clause Compression
formula: non-finite reduced clauses retaining logical subject
example: Though initially rejected, the proposal gained support.

title: Extended Postmodification
formula: noun + multiple restrictive/postmodifying phrases
example: The report submitted yesterday by the team is detailed.

title: Idiomatic Discourse Markers
formula: That said; Be that as it may; All things considered
example: That said, the proposal has merit.

title: Spoken Ellipsis & Repairs
formula: lược phần có thể phục hồi trong lời nói
example: Coming with us?

title: Idiomatic Grammar Patterns
formula: There is no + V-ing; It goes without saying that...
example: There is no denying the impact.

title: Register Shifting
formula: would you mind... (polite) vs do this... (direct)
example: Would you mind closing the window?

title: Active–Passive Stylistic Choice
formula: đặt chủ đề thông tin quan trọng lên đầu câu
example: The samples were analysed overnight.

title: Nominal vs Verbal Style
formula: noun-heavy form vs verb-focused clear writing
example: The team conducted an investigation.

title: Marked Word Order
formula: seldom/only after + inversion; focus-shifting placement
example: Only after the meeting did she reply.

title: Information Structure
formula: old→new information; theme/rheme
example: The proposal was controversial. This controversy delayed approval.

title: Ambiguity & Scope
formula: modifier đặt gần thành phần nó bổ nghĩa
example: She almost finished the report.

title: Advanced Punctuation
formula: semicolon giữa independent clauses; colon giới thiệu giải thích/liệt kê
example: The evidence was clear; the conclusion was not.

title: Pragmatic Grammar & Politeness
formula: could/would/wondering if giúp giảm độ trực diện
example: I was wondering if you could help.

title: Expert Editing & Cohesion
formula: kiểm tra reference, agreement, tense, modifier, register
example: Each participant submitted their response.
